Each epoch contained three 24-second blocks: 1 block each of alcohol (ALC), nonalcohol beverage (BEV), and visual control pictures (VIS) and one 18-second rest (REST) (cross-hair).

description.value: Six 24-second blocks of alcohol-related pictures, with each block presenting five pictures for approximately 4.8 seconds; blocks depicted beer, wine, or liquor cues. model_settings.value: Group-level condition contrasts were formed by averaging each group's functional data at each of 180 time points.
